description_en: Retrieves the description of a specified long-term memory
description_zh: 获取指定长期记忆体的描述信息
name: GetMemory

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the long-term memory belongs. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.help_zh: 长期记忆体所属的业务空间 ID。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the long-term memory, which corresponds to the memoryId returned by the CreateMemory (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/developer-reference/api-bailian-2023-12-29-creatememory) operation
parameters.help_zh: 长期记忆体 ID，对应 CreateMemory (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/developer-reference/api-bailian-2023-12-29-creatememory) 接口返回的`memoryId`
parameters.name: memory_id

description.description_en: The description of the long-term memory
description.description_zh: 长期记忆体的描述信息
description.example: 我的大模型应用$APP_ID关于A用户的长期记忆体

memoryId.description_en: The ID of the long-term memory

workspaceId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the long-term memory belongs
workspaceId.description_zh: 长期记忆体所属的业务空间 ID
